description: Free. Check whether an x402 endpoint or MCP tool is real, payable and active BEFORE you pay it. Pass a URL; get a 0–100 payability score, the listed price and networks, when the catalog last saw it active, how many of the last 30 days its payment address was paid, on-chain USDC payments and distinct paying wallets on Base over 30 days (with a one-wallet wash warning), a live check that it really answers 402 and asks to be paid at its listed address (x402 version, CAIP-2 networks), and flags for catalog-flooding or outlier pricing. Scored from the public PayAI x402 Bazaar + MCP Registry index — listings are third-party data, not endorsed. Returns a 0–100 score, a verdict (payable / mixed / unverified), the listed price, networks and last-active date, plain-language signals, and provider flooding / price-outlier warnings.

maxPriceUsd.description: What you expect to pay per call, in US dollars. If the listed price is higher you'll be warned.

url.description: The endpoint URL (or host) you're about to pay — e.g. 'https://api.example.com/v1/search'.
